description: This file implements a WebSocket connection manager class responsible for handling real-time game state synchronization in a multiplayer game backend. It manages WebSocket connections organized by game ID, allowing targeted broadcasting of game updates and individual messaging.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket connections for real-time game updates, supporting connection, disconnection, broadcasting messages, and connection count queries.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and registers it to a specific game ID, expanding the connection pool for that game.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the specified game's connection pool, cleaning up empty pools.

methods.name: broadcast_to_game(self, game_id: str, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to all WebSocket clients connected to a particular game, handling disconnections during message sending.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, websocket: WebSocket, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message directly to a specified WebSocket client.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, game_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active WebSocket connections associated with a specific game ID.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections across all games.

ctags.name: broadcast_to_game
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast_to_game(self, game_id: str, message: dict):$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str):$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str):$/

ctags.name: send_personal_message
ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_personal_message(self, websocket: WebSocket, message: dict):$/
